packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps
mise's tags are v2026.11.7; the mise-action version input takes 2026.11.7
kindest/node images belong to a kind release
prBodyNotes: Update `KIND_NODE_IMAGE` in `mise.toml` and the two node images in `lint-test.yaml` from this kind release's notes, and the oldest lane's `MISE_KUBECTL_VERSION` to the newest kubectl patch of that Kubernetes minor.

Shyft patch bump, same line: a chart patch release
prBodyNotes: Bump the chart's patch version, add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry and run `mise run docs`, or the `Chart` check fails.

packageRules.description: New Shyft line (major or minor): a chart minor release
prBodyNotes: New Shyft line. Bump the chart's minor version, add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and run `mise run docs`.
